<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial rhetoric:</strong> A fire at Albania’s Supreme Court has triggered a heated exchange between the BJP and Shiv Sena (UBT) regarding the safety and independence of India&#x27;s own judiciary.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxOVnhRd3U2b0tkNVQyQ1dSZ0VoVXlrNmZnN3hsY2swVGp4cFFUd3RvTDkzYlVEOV9IUGpjdThYVklJLUgyckxyRWs0ZFh3ZW40ZHBZejlPbEpGSENMMDl5NHUxUEJWTFNTa29fYmF6YmpfdzBoVU1TaVV2OC0wMWRha2g3bWRqbFV2ODZmQ1I5VGRsZlZQcG5YbmlkMTFRa204SWM0?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission protests:</strong> The INDIA alliance has finalized a strategy in Guna, including demands for the Chief Election Commissioner&#x27;s resignation, while Congress leaders continue protests to pressure the Supreme Court over alleged electoral irregularities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Delimitation deadlock:</strong> The Union government has signaled an upcoming Parliament session to address the Delimitation Bill, urging the opposition to play a constructive role despite recent snubs in formal talks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary oversight:</strong> Law Minister Kiren Rijiju has rejected concerns raised by Mallikarjun Kharge regarding the Parliament prorogation deadline, maintaining the government&#x27;s procedural stance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legal intervention:</strong> The Allahabad High Court has stayed the conviction of a BJP worker, a move that enables the individual to participate in the upcoming election.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
